lines.text: You're red. I can still talk to you. The clinics would prefer I didn't.
Sablier made you. Sablier can make you better. Card's on the desk.
Ninety days on our books, and nobody bills you for them. Remember who didn't.
One of ours. Then you know the clinics don't close. Neither do we.
A signature now. Others will want it. We made the hand that holds the pen.
Sablier made you. That doesn't mean a card chooses your work. Read it yourself.
